name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 4.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 1.46 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
